Name: Faulthawk
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: The elite warriors among the nephilim, who train themselves to excel at frontline or ranged combat. These warriors lead their fellow nephilim into conflicts when they are unavoidable, and protect their most sacred sites. When knowledge or relics must be protected or kept from mortal hands, they are the greatest force to be deployed.

traits.name: Memories of the Heart (4/Day)
traits.description: When the nephilim makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw they can roll 1d4 and add it to the result. If added to an attack roll, another 1d4 is added to the damage from that attack as well.

traits.name: Prismatic Flash (Recharge 4-6)
traits.description: When the nephilim hits with a weapon attack, they can energize the attack with prismatic energy, causing it to deal an extra 27 (6d8) radiant damage, and forcing its target to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure they are blinded for 1 minute, and may repeat the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Rite of Certain Aim
traits.description: When the nephilim makes a ranged weapon attack at their weapon’s long range, they make that attack with neither advantage or disadvantage regardless of if they would have either.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nephilim makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Greatbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: The nephilim takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus_actions.name: Subdermal Illumination
bonus_actions.description: The nephilim causes its body to magically produce bright light out to 20 feet, with dim light twice as far, or causes this light to be extinguished. This light is treated as a spell with a level equal to the nephilim’s proficiency bonus.
